a2t_calibration_identity_hash_convention: a2t_calibration_split_identity_hash is SHA-256 over the LF-joined sorted roster 'key' values (audio2tool:<tier>:<id6>) -- the Audio2Tool probe-receipt integrity convention. a2t_calibration_flight_split_identity_hash is data.splits.split_identity_hash(prefixed('audio2tool', sample_ids)) over audio2tool/<tier>:<id6>, the value core.flight.FlightRuntime.preflight computes at flight time and the value the frozen construction roster docs/receipts/rosters/a2t-evo-fold-b-v2.json carries as its own split_identity_hash. Both cover the same 418 rows.
a2t_calibration_key_names: The a2t_calibration_* key names are the flight-family contract scripts/flights/run_calibration_cell.py and scripts/a2t_calibration_prompt_fit.py read; reusing them is what lets this roster fly through the SAME entry point and the SAME FlightRuntime as every other Audio2Tool direct cell, with no new code path. The keys name a receipt-scoped roster, not the calibration split.
a2t_calibration_population: EVO-A1 fold B under the owner's 2026-09-06 RELAXED-WITH-SENTINELS decision: the same shape as fold A on DISJOINT blocks -- 284 REWARD rows over the 18 fold-capable MF-1 target tools at their contention-resolved quotas, 14 SENTINEL rows over the five thin tools (calibrateCameras 2, getLightState 1, setAmbientLighting 2, setBrightness 6, setRomanceMode 3; whole blocks do not halve, so fold B carries six fewer than fold A), and 120 background rows drawn one-per-block, 15 per tier over all eight tiers, from tools no target names. Frozen by scripts/build_a2t_evo_fold_rosters.py --version v2, seed 20260906, over the V3 exposure-free construction pool restricted to rows whose runtime wav is at most 60 s. Exposure row SAEA-SN-MF-A2T-EVO-FOLD-ROSTERS-V2.
a2t_calibration_strata: gold tool for the 298 targeted rows and tier for the 120 background rows, carried as aggregate counts in the flight-roster receipt and per row in the frozen construction roster beside it. Domain mix: smart_home 295, wearables 61, smart_car 62. Tier mix: tier1 40, tier2 159, tier3 41, tier4 36, tier5 38, tier6 39, tier7 44, tier8 21.
a2t_calibration_sentinel_rows: A SENTINEL row's gold tool is one the corpus cannot supply enough rows of to reward on. It is flown like any other row and it is never a reward row: rails.evolution_carrier._split_fold_rows puts it in the BACKGROUND slice, so it is counted in the confirmation's -1.0 pp background bound and never in the targeted interval a candidate is accepted on. The tools are declared in configs/knowledge/a2t-evo-a1/loop-v1.json.
a2t_calibration_tier7_media_binding: tier7_multiturn rows bind the FIRST user turn -- audio_paths[0] of the released Tier7Dataset._get_audio_paths, the same binding the three sealed official-population rosters and the 4,000 final read use. data.audio2tool._entry_media reads chat_history[-1] instead (the P1 scaffold's final-turn binding), and on all 92 tier-7 rows of the two folds the two differ, so the choice is recorded rather than inherited.
a2t_calibration_d1_media_supplement: All 418 sample ids are outside the immutable D1 identity closure and are carried by the additive receipt named above (schema saea-d1-media-supplement-v1, 93,638,454 bytes of media), built by scripts/build_a2t_semantic_agentloop_d1_supplement.py --roster against the flight-roster receipt. contracts.gate_media_identity.verify_media_identity was run offline against all 418 rows under this supplement and passed, with an unlisted sample id refused as the negative control.
a2t_calibration_scoring_identity: 291 of the 418 sample ids are new to data.audio2tool's frozen-receipt universe and enter it through docs/receipts/probe-samples/a2t-evo-fold-b-v2.json; the other 127 already resolve through a2t-construction-800-v1.json, a construction-role identity view whose own roster has never been flown, and a probe-sample receipt that repeated them would be refused as a duplicate. Without the new receipt a2t-toolcall-official cannot score the fold at all.
a2t_calibration_exposure: Construction-role discovery identities, prepared without model, network, tokenizer, scorer or audio-decoding contact. This fragment grants no contact authority; docs/readiness/2026-09-06-a2t-evo-a1-description-evolution-v1-preregistration.md and the exposure ledger do, and that preregistration is still a DRAFT.
a2t_calibration_no_driver_split_name: This fragment deliberately declares no split_name key. split_id names the receipt-scoped split the calibration adapter resolves from the hash-pinned roster receipt above; it is never resolved through the generic probe-receipt universe.
